vi.title: Quyền tiền và trust boundary
body: Buyer: fund / confirm / dispute trước hạn.
Seller: create / deliver / accept mutual settlement.
Arbitrator: payout hoặc refund tới recipients cố định.
Manager: registry/policy; upgrade authority là quyền riêng.

en.title: Money permissions and trust boundaries
body: Buyer: fund / confirm / dispute before deadline.
Seller: create / deliver / accept mutual settlement.
Arbitrator: fixed-recipient payout or refund.
Manager: registry/policy; upgrade authority is separate.

notes: Original project source: docs/architecture/v06.md, docs/product/README.md and docs/evidence/v06/README.md. Distinguish implementation, deployment and live acceptance. No Mainnet, audit or paid-user claim.

vi.title: State machine chặn chi lặp
body: Created → Funded → Delivered → Completed
Funded quá delivery → Refunded
Delivered tranh chấp → Disputed → payout / refund
Policy 1 xử muộn; terminal đầu tiên thắng.

en.title: The state machine rejects repeated settlement
body: Created → Funded → Delivered → Completed
Missed delivery → Refunded
Timely complaint → Disputed → payout / refund
Policy 1 permits late ruling; the first terminal transaction wins.

notes: Original project source: docs/architecture/v06.md, docs/product/README.md and docs/evidence/v06/README.md. Distinguish implementation, deployment and live acceptance. No Mainnet, audit or paid-user claim.

vi.title: Pending không phải thành công
body: Kiểm tra → ký → gửi → xác nhận → finalized.
Timeout broadcast: theo signature, không ký lại ngay.
Expiry: block height finalized + đọc lại history.
Keeper: retry từng deal; manual finalize ở phần khôi phục.

en.title: Pending is not success
body: Check → sign → submit → confirm → finalized.
Broadcast timeout: follow the signature, do not re-sign immediately.
Expiry: finalized block height plus historical re-read.
Keeper: isolated retries; manual finalize is a recovery action.

notes: Original project source: docs/architecture/v06.md, docs/product/README.md and docs/evidence/v06/README.md. Distinguish implementation, deployment and live acceptance. No Mainnet, audit or paid-user claim.

vi.title: Giữ ABI và điều kiện deal cũ
body: Deal 876 byte; policy byte dùng padding, account cũ mặc định 0.
ManagerConfig 73 byte, Application 59 byte là PDA riêng.
Policy và message có binding; thay trong lúc ký bị chặn.
Nâng cấp: contract → bootstrap → web → smoke.

en.title: Preserve legacy ABI and agreed terms
body: Deal stays 876 bytes; policy uses padding, legacy defaults 0.
Separate PDAs: ManagerConfig 73 bytes, Application 59 bytes.
Policy is bound to consent; changes during signing are rejected.
Upgrade: program → bootstrap → web → smoke.

notes: Original project source: docs/architecture/v06.md, docs/product/README.md and docs/evidence/v06/README.md. Distinguish implementation, deployment and live acceptance. No Mainnet, audit or paid-user claim.
